_comment: Additional permissions continuityops-gha needs to manage terraform/envs/account. Attached by terraform/envs/account/iam-gha-addon.tf (by role name — the role itself is never imported). Verified missing on run 31267523721: AccessDenied on budgets:ModifyBudget and ce:CreateAnomalyMonitor.
_tagging_note: budgets:TagResource added after run 31272457415: the provider's default_tags block tags the budget, and tagging is a separate IAM action from ModifyBudget. Granting ModifyBudget alone gets you a second AccessDenied one call later.
_scope_note: Read-only cost inspection (ce:GetCostAndUsage etc.) is deliberately NOT here — that belongs to continuityops-agent-ro. This addon grants only what is needed to CREATE and maintain the guardrails themselves.
